messages:
olivia: Whoa, never seen fog that thick on the baywalk. Visibility down to a few blocks. Watch your step!

samir: BART sent a delay text  signal issue near Powell. Saying 10-15 but could stretch. :train2:

transit-bot: SERVICE ALERT: BART DELAY BETWEEN MONTGOMERY AND POWELL DUE TO SIGNAL TESTING. Estimated delay 10-20 minutes. https://bart.gov/alerts

gina: Muni announcement on the 8X: "temporary stop closures" around Embarcadero. Driver telling folks to head to Market St stops.

tom: Ferry was slower because of low visibility + wind. Captain announced extra safety checks. I made it on the 8:05 but was late.

facilities-bot: BUILDING NOTICE: 2nd-floor entrance ramp is slippery due to condensation. Floor mats placed; please wipe shoes. Ticket #FLT-3344.

maya: I left a bag of granola bars by the front desk for hungry soggy commuters. :granola_bar: first-come.

olivia: Also, if anyone finds a navy beanie with a small white logo, that's mine. Lost it on the Bay Bridge shuttle.

samir: Quick poll: standup virtual until midday? React :house_with_garden: for yes, :office: for no.

gina: :house_with_garden: will tune in from dry couch.

tom: :office: I'll be there dripping but committed.

maya: FYI, if you parked by the loading bay, one of the bike racks flooded a bit. We put a notice on the rack board.

olivia: Meme: "When the fog has better commute tips than your app" (posted a tiny fog GIF). :rofl:

samir: Thanks for the granola, Maya. Heading in early to avoid the BART crowd. Stay safe everyone!
